brief: Sends real HTTP requests through the reactor's curl client and reports only a body, with status 200 or 0.
detail: It is the live side of the HTTP port, with the same Request(method, url, body) shape as stzHttpSandbox. The reactor's client returns a body and no status line, so the adapter answers status 200 when content came back and 0 when nothing did; headers, redirects and non-2xx bodies are not seen. It was run only against a listener started on 127.0.0.1 in the same process, which never answers, and against a closed port: both gave status 0. The 200 path was read from the code and not run.
